sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We will continue to roll out new programmes to keep pace with the evolving needs of the transition to a green economy.

sections.label: Land transport emissions share
sections.summary: The land transport system is Singapore's third largest source of emissions, accounting for 15% of national emissions today.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Our land transport system is an important part of this endeavour.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: It is our third largest source of emissions, accounting for 15% of national emissions today.

sections.label: Land transport emissions reduction target
sections.summary: Land transport carbon emissions peaked at 7.7 million tonnes in 2016, and Singapore aims to reduce land transport emissions by 80% by or around mid-century from that peak.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: As a result of these moves and other changes, I am happy to share with Members that our land transport carbon emissions peaked at 7.7 million tonnes in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: While this is a significant inflection, we must do more to work towards net-zero emissions, as stated by Senior Minister Teo Chee Hean.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Hence, aligned with our national effort, we aim to reduce land transport emissions by 80% by or around mid-century, from the peak in 2016.

sections.label: Electric car registrations increase
sections.summary: New electric car registrations in Singapore increased 18-fold, from 100 in 2020 to 1,800 in 2021, almost 4% of all new car registrations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: In Singapore, new electric car registrations increased 18-fold, from 100 in 2020 to 1,800 in 2021, accounting for almost 4% of all new car registrations.

sections.label: Category A COE threshold for EVs
sections.summary: MOT will raise the Category A MPO threshold for electric cars from 97 kilowatts to 110 kilowatts, doubling Category A models from 10 to 20, applying to COEs from May 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: So, Mr Saktiandi Supaat would be pleased that MOT has reviewed the MPO threshold between Category A and Category B COEs for electric cars.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: We will be increasing the Category A MPO threshold for electric cars from 97 kilowatts to 110 kilowatts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Based on the EV models approved by LTA for use so far, this move will double the number of models that fall within Category A from 10 to 20, including models like the Hyundai Ioniq that Mr Louis Chua mentioned in his speech.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: This change will apply to electric cars registered using COEs obtained from the next COE quarter in May 2022.

sections.label: e-taxi statutory lifespan extended
sections.summary: The Government will extend the statutory lifespan of e-taxis to 10 years from the current eight years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: To support these initiatives and higher ambitions, the Government will extend the statutory lifespan of e-taxis to 10 years, up from the current eight years.

sections.label: EV adoption and carbon footprint
sections.summary: HDB towns will be EV-ready by 2025, with COE threshold adjustments, infrastructure and regulation, and half of public buses and taxis electric by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: We will make every HDB town EV-ready by 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: We will support EV adoption with adjustments to our COE Category A MPO threshold, upgraded electrical infrastructure and a robust regulatory framework for EV charging and ensure half our public buses and taxi fleets are electric by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Based on LTA’s estimates, compared to driving an ICE car, switching to an electric car halves our carbon footprint.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Taking an electric bus reduces our carbon footprint by 70%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Taking the MRT reduces our carbon footprint by close to 90%.

sections.label: Building carbon emissions share
sections.summary: Buildings contribute more than 20% of Singapore's carbon emissions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Our buildings contribute more than 20% of Singapore’s carbon emissions.

sections.label: Singapore Green Building Masterplan targets
sections.summary: The latest Singapore Green Building Masterplan was launched last year with three targets, '80-80-80 in 2030'.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Last year, we launched the latest edition of the Singapore Green Building Masterplan (SGBMP).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We set three targets: “80-80-80 in 2030”, to push further in greening our buildings.

sections.label: Buildings greened to date
sections.summary: More than 49% of Singapore's buildings have been greened to date.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: To date, we have greened more than 49% of our buildings.

sections.label: New SLE-certified buildings
sections.summary: Over the past year, close to 7% of new buildings by GFA were certified as SLE buildings.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Over the past year, we have certified close to 7% of new buildings by GFA as SLE buildings.

sections.label: HDB solar capacity progress
sections.summary: Solar panels installed on over 2,700 HDB blocks, targeting 540 MWp capacity by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Mr Abdul Samad asked how we are progressing with these plans.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We have done this for more than 2,700 blocks already, more than a quarter of the over 10,000 HDB blocks we have in Singapore today.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: By 2030, we target to have a solar capacity of 540 MWp, equivalent to powering 135,000 4-room flats.

sections.label: MSCP food production tenders
sections.summary: Since 2020, HDB and SFA have launched tenders for 16 sites on MSCPs for food production.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Since 2020, HDB and SFA have launched tenders for 16 sites on MSCPs for food production.

sections.label: Species Recovery Programme expansion
sections.summary: The Species Recovery Programme expanded from 94 to 120 species last year, with a target of 160 species by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Last year, we expanded the Species Recovery Programme from 94 to 120 species and, by 2030, we will increase these to 160 species.

sections.label: Nature Ways and park connectors
sections.summary: Over half of 300 kilometres of Nature Ways are complete, with around 370 kilometres of park connectors done.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Third, we have continued to enhance connectivity between our green spaces to help our native flora disperse and our fauna to traverse our island.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We have completed more than half of the 300 kilometres of Nature Ways that we aim to implement by 2030 and we are on track to meeting our target of 500 kilometres of park connectors by 2030, with around 370 kilometres of park connectors completed so far.

sections.label: Households near parks
sections.summary: Over nine in 10 households are within a 10-minute walk from a park, aiming for 100% by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Over nine in 10 households are now within a 10-minute walk from a park and we aim to reach 100% by 2030.

sections.label: Tiles for native species
sections.summary: Specially-designed tiles can host native species like crabs and sea snails, and will be piloted at Pulau Tekong.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: These specially-designed tiles can host a range of native species, such as crabs and sea snails, more abundantly than conventional seawalls.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: They will be piloted at Pulau Tekong and have the potential to be applied to other parts of Singapore.

sections.label: Technology, energy use, R&D investment
sections.summary: This technology aims to reduce energy use while providing comfort, and an additional $64 million will be invested into R&D under the Cities of Tomorrow programme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: This technology aims to reduce energy use while still providing comfort for the occupants.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: I am glad to share that we will invest an additional $64 million into R&D under the City in Nature and Greater Sustainability pillars of the Cities of Tomorrow programme.

sections.label: Education, institutions, workforce sustainability
sections.summary: Foundational education in schools will be a key enabler, but the capabilities of institutions and competencies of graduates and the workforce will be the real needle movers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, to achieve sustainability as our competitive advantage for Singapore, foundational education in our schools will be a key enabler; but the capabilities of our institutions – Universities, Polytechnics and ITE – and the competencies of our graduates and the workforce, will be the real needle movers.

sections.label: Institutions supporting sustainable living, green economy
sections.summary: Institutions can contribute to the national sustainability push in two needle-moving areas.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Miss Rachel Ong has asked how our institutions are stepping up efforts to support sustainable living and the green economy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: There are two needle-moving areas that our institutions can contribute to the national sustainability push.

sections.label: NYP Centre, SMEs, energy-efficient initiatives
sections.summary: Through the Centre, NYP staff and students will work with 100 small and medium enterprises by 2023 to co-create and implement energy-efficient initiatives.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Through the Centre, NYP staff and students will work with 100 small and medium enterprises by 2023, to co-create and implement energy-efficient initiatives.

sections.label: Green skills, job roles, sectors
sections.summary: The Skills Demand for the Future Economy report noted that over 450 job roles across 17 sectors already require green skills in their job tasks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: The "Skills Demand for the Future Economy" report by SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG) noted that over 450 job roles across 17 sectors already require green skills in their job tasks.

sections.label: LifeSkills, CET courses, green skills
sections.summary: Students will explore sustainability issues under the LifeSkills framework, and institutions offer more than 100 CET courses providing training in areas such as sustainable built environment and green finance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: As part of the enhanced LifeSkills framework, students at our institutions will also explore and discuss sustainability-related issues and how these relate to their roles as global citizens.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: These allow students to acquire and apply green skills in real-world settings and better prepare them for future careers in green jobs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We will ramp up our Continuing Education and Training (CET) courses for those already working in industries that face a "green transition".

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Currently, our institutions offer more than 100 CET courses that provide training in areas, such as sustainable built environment, green engineering solutions, green finance and environmental sciences.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: One example is Temasek Polytechnic's Specialist Diploma in Energy Management and Sustainable Design which upskills workers in the building industry to take on job opportunities in energy efficiency design and technologies.

sections.label: Bank capital for carbon credits
sections.summary: MAS treats banks' carbon credit exposure like commodities, with internationally agreed risk-weights calibrated to demonstrated riskiness.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Under the MAS' bank capital framework, banks' exposure to carbon credits are treated similarly as exposures to commodities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: The risk-weight is agreed internationally in the capital standards promulgated by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision and has been calibrated very carefully based on demonstrated riskiness of the commodities and carbon credits.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: So, we will have to be very careful in adjusting the risk-weighting for some of these assets because it may inadvertently expose the banks and financial institutions to unacceptable risks.

sections.label: EV upfront cost adjustments
sections.summary: The EV Early Adoption Incentive with the Vehicle Emission Scheme can cut upfront cost by up to $45,000 depending on car OMV.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Second, we have also introduced the upfront ownership cost adjustments through the EV Early Adoption Incentive which, when combined with the Vehicle Emission Scheme (VES), can result in a reduction of up to $45,000 in the upfront cost, depending on the OMV of the car.

sections.label: Tracking and verifying carbon reductions
sections.summary: Capability in tracking, verification and auditing of claimed carbon reductions is important, and standards and a verification system will be developed with industries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: In fact, I mentioned this in my speech, that as we embark on projects on reducing our carbon emission as well as new projects like carbon capture and so on, it is very important for us to develop our capability in tracking and verification in auditing some of these carbon reductions that they claim.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: In time to come, we will work with the various industries to set standards and work out a system where we can verify the actual carbon emission and the carbon savings that they have achieved.

sections.label: Low-carbon energy R&D funding
sections.summary: $55 million of R&D projects were awarded last year under the Low-carbon Energy Research Funding Initiative for low-carbon technologies such as hydrogen.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: For example, I mentioned that, last year, we awarded $55 million of R&D projects under the Low-carbon Energy Research Funding Initiative to pursue R&D in low-carbon technologies, such as hydrogen.

sections.label: SME feedback on loan terms
sections.summary: Despite 70% Government risk-sharing, industry feedback mainly from SMEs is that interest rates and loan terms are not much different from commercial loans.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har
sentences.text: As I said, despite the generous Government risk-sharing at 70%, the industry's feedback, mainly coming from the SMEs, is that the interest rate and loan terms offered by the participating financial institutions are actually not much different from commercial loans.

sections.label: Refining green schemes feedback
sections.summary: Industry feedback will be taken in to refine schemes including EFS-Green, while ensuring schemes and projects are viable for sustainable outcomes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: The short answer is yes, we will take in the feedback from industries and to continue to refine our various schemes, including EFS-Green, so that they are relevant and are able to help the industries in embarking on this sustainability journey.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: But we also have to bear in mind that we have to also ensure that these schemes and these projects make sense and are viable, so that we have a sustainable outcome for the sustainable projects.
